title: Necromantic Thirst
description: Necromantic Thirst is a 32-map megawad created by the French Doom Community. Inspired by classic WADs of yesteryear, its progression transforms classic UAC techbases into a twisted, green and black hellish world spanning industrial and medieval environments. The set also introduces a custom monster called the Hunter of Darkness, a variant of the Hell knight with 750 hit points.
